title: Mars Opens Hyderabad GCC With Genpact to Expand Digital, AI Capabilities
summary: The 60,000 sq ft facility will initially have more than 400 Genpact employees, with Mars aiming to transition to 1,000 of its associates over time.
llm_summary: Mars has partnered with Genpact to launch a 60,000‑sq‑ft Global Capability Center in Hyderabad, focused on scaling its digital and AI initiatives. The site will start with over 400 Genpact staff, and Mars plans to gradually increase its own workforce there to about 1,000
